clients.projectContext: AgileMind is a Grapevine, Texas-based educational technology company founded in 2002 that develops research-based mathematics and science curriculum programs (grades 6–12) for U.S. school districts. Their blended learning model combines print student activity books (SABs) with digital instructional platforms; products are sold on annual contracts to districts and carry regional ISBNs that vary by state. AgileMind was acquired by Savvas Learning Company in 2020 and operates with approximately 51–100 employees.

Homage (homage.com) is a Columbus, OH-based direct-to-consumer apparel brand specializing in vintage and retro-styled licensed merchandise across major sports leagues (NFL, MLB, NBA, WNBA, MLS, NCAA) and pop culture franchises (Star Wars, Marvel, Disney). They sell through a single Shopify Plus storefront and distribute via EDI to licensed-apparel retailers including Fanatics, Dick's Sporting Goods, and Rallyhouse. They operate a meaningful in-house engineering stack on AWS and are executing a competitive iPaaS evaluation to replace Celigo.

The Clorox Company is a global Fortune 500 consumer packaged goods company (~$7B revenue, ~8,700 employees) headquartered in Oakland, CA. DataSkate is actively engaged on a Celigo + NetSuite integration project. Clorox uses Celigo as enterprise iPaaS middleware for third-party system integrations, specifically CloudExtend by Celigo for NetSuite implementations. Integration pattern: Celigo as middleware connecting business applications, streamlining data workflows, and automating processes across their enterprise tech stack. Key credibility use: named reference for DataSkate's Celigo migration expertise in competitive evaluations (e.g., Homage).
clients._credibilityNote: Named referenceable client for Celigo + NetSuite engagements. Clorox's enterprise scale and Fortune 500 status makes this the strongest possible social proof for mid-market Celigo migration prospects like Homage. Always reference as 'actively working with The Clorox Company on a Celigo + NetSuite integration engagement' — do not describe as completed.

Peerless Fence Group is the largest independently owned fence contractor in the Midwest — a 60+ year, family-founded rollup of regional Illinois/Indiana fencing businesses headquartered in St. Charles, IL, operating across Illinois, Indiana, Ohio, and southern Wisconsin. Acquired January 1, 2023 by Chicago-based private equity firm Akoya Capital Partners as a Home Services platform investment, Peerless has grown through ~10 bolt-on acquisitions since 2013 and now operates its residential pipeline through Home Depot's Pro-contractor channel: leads land in HD Portal, flow into Salesforce CRM, then move to ComputerEase (Deltek) for job costing and accounting.
